businesses.business: advertising and marketing communications agency holding company

offering_description.value: Provides advertising, media planning and buying, public relations, customer engagement, data and commerce marketing services to corporations and brands. Delivers through a network of agency brands staffed by creative, media and analytics teams, and with proprietary data and technology platforms.

primary_services.value: advertising and creative services; media planning and buying; public relations; customer relationship and commerce marketing; marketing data analytics and technology

customer_segment.value: B2B: large multinational corporations and brands across consumer and business sectors

end_markets.value: consumer goods; technology; healthcare and pharmaceuticals; financial services; automotive; retail

revenue_model.value: service fees: fees and retainers for advertising, creative, PR and marketing services; commissions or management fees: media buying commissions and fees based on client media spend; project or contract: campaign and project-based marketing engagements
revenue_model.category: service fees; commissions or management fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: service provider: buys media space and creative production inputs, sells integrated marketing services to advertisers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, Middle East and Africa

specialization.value: related lines: advertising, media, public relations, precision marketing and commerce, and healthcare marketing

notes: Omnicom completed its acquisition of Interpublic Group in late 2025; description reflects combined business.
